en: Vintage black‑and‑white winter street scene in a European mountain town. Snow covers the rooftops and a large bare tree; people in early 20th‑century clothing are skiing and standing in groups along a main street lined with multi‑storey houses and shops. At the bottom left there is printed white text with the place name, and shop signs are visible on the buildings.
